  "candidate_rtl": "module comparator_16bit (
    input [15:0] A,
    input [15:0] B,
    output gt,
    output eq,
    output lt
);
    wire [15:0] bg, bl;
    wire [7:0] pg, pl;
    wire [3:0] qg, ql;
    wire [3:0] gp, lp;

    assign bg = A & ~B;
    assign bl = ~A & B;

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : pairs
            assign pg[i] = bg[2*i+1] | (~bl[2*i+1] & bg[2*i]);
            assign pl[i] = bl[2*i+1] | (~bg[2*i+1] & bl[2*i]);
        end
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin : quartets
            assign qg[i] = pg[2*i+1] | (~pl[2*i+1] & pg[2*i]);
            assign ql[i] = pl[2*i+1] | (~pg[2*i+1] & pl[2*i]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign gp = ~ql;
    assign lp = ~qg;

    assign gt = qg[3]
              | (gp[3] & qg[2])
              | (gp[3] & gp[2] & qg[1])
              | (gp[3] & gp[2] & gp[1] & qg[0]);

    assign lt = ql[3]
              | (lp[3] & ql[2])
              | (lp[3] & lp[2] & ql[1])
              | (lp[3] & lp[2] & lp[1] & ql[0]);

    assign eq = ~(gt | lt);
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The previous candidate puts XNOR-based equality detection ahead of a serial hierarchy of comparison merges. Its upper merges also serialize the final eight-bit and sixteen-bit decisions.",
  "rewrite": "Use dual greater/less summaries with non-strict propagation instead of equality propagation. Build two-bit and four-bit summaries, then expand the final four-way comparison into parallel product terms. Derive equality from the mutually exclusive strict comparison results, eliminating the separate equality tree.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Targets lower input-stage delay and less serial comparison merging than the previous candidate. The final equality NOR adds a stage to the equality path. A numerical timing improvement requires the specified mapping and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Removes all explicit XNOR cells and the independent equality tree, using the saved logic budget for final-stage lookahead. Actual mapped area, the 547.775360um2 cap, and zero slew/capacitance violations must be checked in the evaluation flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Exact unsigned 16-bit combinational comparison for every binary A and B. A strict high-group win dominates lower groups; otherwise a lower-group win propagates whenever the high group is not a strict loss. Consequently gt and lt match the original comparisons, and their complemented union is exactly equality. Module name, ports, widths, and unsigned declarations are preserved; there are no parameters, state, assumptions, or dependencies."
